purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and schema-first anonymous public geometry review.
assessment: The City of St. Louis Assessor maintains plat maps for all parcels and publishes current parcel data. Metadata for the public Lots polygon layer was reviewed; the bounded point query requested only OBJECTID and geometry and timed out. The city’s whole-city shapefile was not downloaded, so no geometry sample or point coverage is claimed.
registryAssessment: The City of St. Louis Assessor’s Records and Mapping section says it records real-property transfers and maintains assessment plat maps of all parcels. The official city data page publishes a weekly-updated current-parcels shapefile with key field HANDLE; the City also lists an interactive parcel map and an ArcGIS service. This is a city assessment/parcel-mapping source, not verified title or legal-survey geometry.

geometryDecision.reason: Layer metadata exposes property-record attributes, so the bounded query allowlisted OBJECTID only plus geometry. The official REST query timed out after 15 seconds. The official downloadable current-parcels file is a whole-city shapefile and was not fetched; no full geometry sample is verified.
